name: tsukini-skills
description: Skills of TsukiNi22 for Claude Code (C++ / libutils, docs, git, style, tests, audits, legal) and their routers

plugins.name: cpp-skills
plugins.description: C++: project setup, classes / architecture, style, comments, CMake (skills: cmake-style, cpp-class, cpp-comments, cpp-project, cpp-style)

plugins.name: libutils-skills
plugins.description: libutils: API reference, exceptions, install / update, setup in a project (skills: libutils, libutils-exception, libutils-install, libutils-setup)

plugins.name: doc-skills
plugins.description: Documentation: README, GitHub wiki, uniform HTML docs with the project graph, HTML style, explanation pages (simple + technical), protocol / wire format docs, Markdown / PDF reports, update of every doc / site / package / install script after changes (skills: docs-update, explain-doc, html-doc, html-style, protocol-doc, readme-style, report, wiki-style)

plugins.name: ai-skills
plugins.description: AI context: token-minimal texts and outputs, --rtk modes of programs, questions asked through the built-in QCM / Q&A popup, clarification of unclear requests before acting and ideation (ideas, recommendations, opinions, variants) through that popup (skills: clarify, ideation, interactive-questions, rtk)

plugins.name: git-skills
plugins.description: Git conventions and local commit of the pending diff (commits, branches, pull requests, changelog), the pre-commit hooks and the CI/CD workflows (skills: ci-cd, git-commit, git-conventions, pre-commit)

plugins.name: style-skills
plugins.description: Code style and comments for the other languages (skills: coding-style, comments)

plugins.name: python-skills
plugins.description: Python: project setup, files / classes scaffolding, style and comments (skills: python-class, python-comments, python-project, python-style)

plugins.name: test-skills
plugins.description: Unit tests: GoogleTest (C++), the other frameworks, coverage (skills: coverage, cpp-tests, tests)

plugins.name: audit-skills
plugins.description: Audits: bugs / UB, security (passes fixing every flaw until a clean one), quality, dependencies (licenses, vulnerabilities), benchmark / profiling (skills: audit-bugs, audit-security, audit-deps, audit-quality, benchmark)

plugins.name: legal-skills
plugins.description: Legal side of a project: its license, and the compliance check and setup - GDPR / RGPD, cookies, legal notice, terms, consumer law, accessibility (RGAA, EAA), language, licenses and credits, mandatory mentions, DSA, AI Act, CRA, NIS2, Data Act - global or web (skills: legal-check, legal-setup, license)

plugins.name: system-skills
plugins.description: System: free space on the computer and in the data of Claude Code / claude-cluster, chosen in a QCM (skills: computer-clean)

plugins.name: ux-skills
plugins.description: Interface of a project or a website: several languages (multilingual-project, multilingual-website) and visual modes light / dark / system / high contrast (color-modes-project, color-modes-website) (skills: multilingual-project, multilingual-website, color-modes-project, color-modes-website)
